title: Enclosures.
officialText:
Enclosures of floor furnaces shall be constructed entirely of noncombustible materials with a fire-resistance rating
of at least 1-hour and the enclosure shall be provided with adequate outdoor air to ensure proper combustion. The enclosure shall be
provided with adequate means of access for servicing the furnace.
